title: console.alert
description: host → server → client (relayed unchanged). A parameter of one console went out of limits. Opens the window in which the matching callout earns a Good Call. Delivered only to the holder(s) of role.

arg.description: Number that is part of the callout (e.g. engine 3); null when none.

endsAtMs.description: Server clock when the Good Call window closes.

AlertId.description: Console alert identifier chosen by the host; unique within the room.

DataId.description: Identifier of an entry in the shared game data (`data/`): part, part category, contract, test, anomaly card, minigame, fact, codex entry, callout, console request, award, objective, validation rule, cosmetic. 1–48 characters.

RoleId.description: Mission Control role (§3.3), in canonical order.

TimeMs.description: Absolute time on the server clock: integer milliseconds since the Unix epoch. Every `…AtMs` field in the protocol uses the server clock (see Clock).
